intent.summary: Presents human-readable textual content with semantic typography and localization behavior.
avoidWhen: Text is solely an icon substitute without an accessible name

semantics.sizing: intrinsic to shaped text subject to wrapping, truncation, and parent constraints
semantics.ordering: characters follow Unicode bidirectional and locale rules

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Semantic typography role rather than a platform font name.

attributes.name: lineLimit
attributes.description: Maximum rendered line count; omission means unconstrained.

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.description: Inline alignment within the text bounds.

attributes.name: overflow
attributes.description: Behavior when content exceeds available bounds.

accessibility.focusBehavior: not focusable unless interactive semantics are added by another pattern
notes: Preserve localization, reading direction, and dynamic text scaling.

mappings.strategy: Capture localized content, semantic font role, line policy, and alignment.
caveats: Label may also contain an image and should be decomposed when necessary.

mappings.strategy: Map content, text style resource, wrapping, trimming, and alignment.
